prerequisites: The student has acquired at least 140 CFU in his career.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire specific practical skills arising in the course of an internship of three months.

syllabus_topics: Internship in a company for a period of three months (and at least 360 hours)
Presentation and discussion of a report on the activities carried out during the internship
assessment_rules: The final test is the presentation and discussion of a report on the activities carried out during the internship. At the end of the Internship, the student must hand in the report to the company and to the tutor, which will be presented and discussed during the final test. The form of the report will be agreed with the tutor / company mentor.
institution: Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia — Ingegneria Informatica (MO)
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Mo) (Computer Engineering (D.M.270/04)), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
